TeeMail/OpTee | Sales | USA Remote | Commission-based| teemail.io We're building automation tools for the golf industry. TeeMail handles inbound booking inquiries for golf courses automatically — parses emails, checks availability, sends responses. OpTee is a dashboard for tour operators managing tee time inventory across multiple courses. Live customers include premium resorts in Ireland and USA. Looking for someone to own US sales. The role:

Commission-based, uncapped Target: golf courses, resorts, tour operators, destination management companies Short sales cycles, clear ROI pitch (staff time savings, faster response = more bookings)

Good fit if you:

Have golf industry connections or hospitality/travel tech sales experience Can work independently and actually close deals Want equity upside in an early-stage company

Stack: Python, PostgreSQL, NLP for email parsing, integrations with booking systems Interested? Email info@teemail.io with a bit about your background and how you'd approach the US golf market.
